'''Rannek Gisk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] Republic officer at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], he was stationed on [[Avesta Plantation]] specializing as a bioanalysis trainer for the Republic strike force.
